spells.name: Detect Alignment (All alignments simultaneously)(Constant)
spells.text:
Your eyes glow as you sense aligned auras. Choose chaotic, evil, good, or lawful. You detect auras of that alignment. You receive no information beyond presence or absence. You can choose not to detect creatures or effects you're aware have that alignment.

Only creatures of 6th level or higher-unless divine spellcasters, undead, or beings from the Outer Sphere-have alignment auras.

---

Heightened (2nd) You learn each aura's location and strength.

items.name: +1 Status to All Saves vs. Magic
Aslynn's Gaze
items.text:
Aslynn gazes upon a creature, afflicting it with intense distress and a gnawing sense of impending doom; the creature must attempt a DC 17 Will save save. Since this effect isn't visual, the creature doesn't need to be able to see Aslynn to be affected.

---

Critical Success The target is unaffected and is temporarily immune to Aslynn's gaze for 1 day.

Success The target is Frightened 1.

Failure The target is frightened 1 and Slowed 1 for 1 round.

Critical Failure The target is Frightened 2 and slowed 1 for 1 minute.

items.name: Nightmarish Wounds
items.text: Wounds caused by Aslynn's claws cause creatures to dwell on their worst nightmares. A creature damaged by Aslynn's claw must succeed at a DC 17 Fortitude save save or be Stupefied 1 for 1 day. On a critical failure, or if it gets hit again and fails its save a second time, it's Stupefied 2 for 1 day.
